purpose: Pause long enough to distinguish durable infrastructure, active research fronts, evidentiary bottlenecks, and the next bounded sprint leg without confusing motion with progress.

layers.name: Security-state organism proof surface
layers.strength: The project can test common purpose, differentiation, metabolism, coordination, reproduction, feedback, visibility, and coercion or extraction without using adjacency as proof.
layers.constraint: Breadth substantially exceeds source-bounded depth; packet count and routing cannot establish the organism thesis.

layers.name: Epistemic jurisdiction and evidence lake
layers.strength: The estate separates inference authority, thresholds, burdens, timing, custody, counterfactuals, exceptions, error, remedy, and direct voice.
layers.constraint: Many core systems remain institutionally legible but person-level chains, production thresholds, practical exits, and contribution-to-benefit ledgers remain incomplete.

layers.name: Global evidence circulation
layers.strength: Global circulation now preserves jurisdiction, language, source class, provenance, candidates, failures, and a strict expected-basin denominator.
layers.constraint: Execution completeness is true while coverage health and evidentiary sufficiency remain false; 55.2 percent public-route success is not a healthy source ecology.

layers.name: Story ecology and answerable power
layers.strength: Standalone actor stories, exact overlaps, constitutional mechanisms, answer stories, and non-links can now coexist without collapsing into one narrative.
layers.constraint: Observed answers are distributed across cases; no single durable arrangement combines pre-action standing, evidence access, burden shift, reversal, public substitution, co-governance, and value recovery. R6 and R7 remain unobserved.

bedrock: pattern recognition is preserved as a prior but cannot self-promote
legal organization, functional organ, and integrated organism remain distinct
standalone story, pairwise overlap, and common purpose remain distinct
feedback and formal review remain distinct from compulsory counterpower
execution completeness, coverage health, and evidentiary sufficiency remain distinct
active_fronts: one exact Matt Clifford decision file
one bounded Clifford-Anduril bridge or non-link
systemic_bottlenecks: final causal joins are concentrated in private drafts, decision memoranda, procurement attachments, production configurations, logs, and direct-person records
institutional records are easier to acquire than represented-person voice
formal rights are more visible than observed implementation and durability
source accessibility is geographically and institutionally uneven
narrative coherence can outrun proposition-level ceilings unless every story is generated from canonical dispositions
sustainable_loop: preserve the exact non-link or missing transition
advance one direct-voice or counterpower object
repair one source or compiler weakness

selected_next_leg.title: Freeze one Matt Clifford decision file
selected_next_leg.selected_decision_family: AI Opportunities Action Plan and the creation of its implementation-adviser role
selected_next_leg.selection_reason: The current official record already joins commission, report, appointment, implementation remit, and declared interests, while leaving authorship, selection, conflicts, alternatives, decision authority, and observed consequence as exact acquisition objects.
